revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_008
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 8, GOLD rank, third gold medal in the final group of four. Based on the Chinese title concept "我要打包银河系的爱给你" and the joke that even love can be delivered. The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, definitely a rectangular ivory postcard/envelope body with rounded corners and envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 8 gag: the postcard mascot is a cosmic delivery worker carrying a tiny glowing galaxy parcel shaped like a heart nebula, with a no-text delivery pouch, looking proud and overworked.
Medal border: GOLD rank level 3 of 4: ornate gold ring with strong side wings or laurel wings, larger crown, more layered trim, visible galaxy sparkle and energy trails, clearly more advanced than tier 7 but not final ultimate.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: warm gold plus cosmic blue-purple glow, funny heroic delivery energy.
Color palette: metallic gold border, ivory mascot, gold sparks, tiny blue-purple galaxy heart parcel; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
